entry.title: F4 Phantom 1.2.0
entry.summary: ## F4 Phantom 1.2.0 A real delay, a real reverb, a new skin, and 194 factory sounds in 30 genres. **One download works on every MPC.** The release zip carries both the 32-bit and the 64-bit build, so there is no way to install the wrong one. (The earlier release shipped separate 32-bit and 64-bit zips; they are gone.) ### What is new - **Delay** — a tempo-syncable delay with a fractional read (the echo arrives exactly on the sample, even at a half-sample offset), a filtered and saturated feedbac
